services.name: Arizona Memorial, Pearl Harbor and Honolulu City Highlights Tour (2B)
services.desc: SUMMARY Embark on an unforgettable journey through the rich history of Pearl Harbor and the vibrant city of Honolulu with our combo tour experience. Immerse yourself in the experience while we handle the driving for you in our deluxe touring vehicle. Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration. Begin your day at the Pearl Harbor Visitor Center, where you'll delve into the poignant exhibits and historic displays at your own pace. services.name: Premium Pearl Harbor Experience
services.desc: SUMMARY Explore Pearl Harbor and relive the historic events of World War II in the Pacific on this small group tour aboard a mini coach. Immerse yourself in the experience while we handle the driving for you in our deluxe touring vehicle. Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration. Amenities and a delicious lunch enhance the visit to the Arizona Memorial and Battleship Missouri which represent the beginning and end of WWII. services.desc: SUMMARY Embark on a captivating journey through history with our WWII Heroes Adventure Tour, an immersive exploration of Pearl Harbor. Immerse yourself in the experience while we handle the driving for you in our deluxe touring vehicle. Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration. Designed for history enthusiasts and those seeking a profound encounter with the past, this comprehensive tour includes tickets to all four main attractions and a delectable lunch at the Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum. Begin your day with a solemn yet enlightening experience as you ride the Navy boat across the harbor

services.name: Oahu Grand Circle Island Tour – Waimea Valley & Dole Plantation (7B)
services.desc: SUMMARY Embark on a captivating journey through the enchanting island of Oahu, immersing yourself in its mesmerizing landscapes and cultural treasures. Immerse yourself in the experience while we handle the driving for you in our deluxe touring vehicle. Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration. Our day-long adventure begins in Honolulu and winds along the breathtaking south shore, leading you to the iconic north shore—a must-experience for all ages. Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration.

services.name: Best of Maui: Sips, Sites & Bites (M1)
services.desc: Best of Maui Tour, Featuring Haleakala, 'Iao Valley, and Country Towns The Essential Maui Tour Experience Maui’s highlights on this laid-back journey showcasing nature’s finery, historic landmarks, and charming country towns. Haleakala is truly magnificent in the daytime hours while bathed in sunlight which brings its steep slopes to center stage and when endemic wildlife freely roam the landscape. Leisurely observe Nene geese in their native habitat and discover the secret of the rare Silversword plant. We’ll stop at Makawao town where you can browse unique shops and galleries. Known for its sunny weather and relaxed vibe, Makawao is the place to be. Make a brief stop at Kula Marketplace

services.name: Road to Hana Adventure Tour (M2)
services.desc: Road to Hana Adventure Tour Scenic Journey on Hawai'i's Most Famous Highway If you visit Maui, you absolutely must travel the picturesque Road to Hana, and enjoy it in the comfort of a mini coach with a professional driver. We provide the best way to fully experience the incredible 620 curves and beautiful 59 single-lane bridges along the way. Stop along the way at some of the most well-known locations in Hana, including a park where you can swim in a waterfall fed-pool (weather permitting). Relax and enjoy and included lunch on an organic farm. We’ve shared the Road to Hana with tens of thousands of guests over the decades and would love to have you join us. services.name: Haleakala Sunrise Tour (Breakfast Included) (M3)
services.desc: Haleakala Sunrise Tour (Breakfast Included) Viewing the Maui sunrise atop Haleakala is among the most sought-after experiences in the islands. The other worldly landscape, altitude, unique flora, and pervasive influence of ancient Hawaiian culture combine to create an event simply beyond imagination. Translated from Hawaiian, Haleakala means “House of the Sun”, and as the most experienced of Haleakala tour providers and operators of the finest vehicles for the trip, Polynesian Adventure Tours is ideally qualified to share the rising of the sun with you. services.name: Haleakala Sunset Tour - A Spectacular Show (M5)
services.desc: Haleakala Sunset Tour Dazzling Twilight Show A sensational solar experience and incredible panoramic views from atop Haleakala at 9,740 feet elevation. Marvel at the show of dazzling light and breathtaking colors. The early departure time for sunrise viewing may be challenging for some and families love touring in the evening. Join us for an equally impressive sunset viewing from the “House of the Sun” in Haleakala National Park. A fabulous finale to a wonderful Maui vacation. Tour Highlights: Hotel pickup in a mini coach with large windows for viewing Haleakala’s landscape. services.desc: Hawai'i Island Volcano Tour Adventure The Ultimate Experience Discover the source of Hawai’i Island’s creation at Hawai’i Volcanoes National Park! Explore cascading waterfalls, craters, and the tsunami-stricken city of Hilo on this comprehensive volcano adventure tour. Bear witness to the 2018 eruption that drastically altered the island’s landscape. Peer into the depths of Halemaumau Crater which has remarkably doubled in size and watch steam clouds form as ground water seeps onto hot volcanic rock at the famous Steam Vents. services.desc: Volcano Adventure Tour from Hilo with Helicopter Helicopter fare included Discover the source of the creation of the Hawaiian Islands at Hawai’i Volcanoes National Park! Explore cascading waterfalls, craters and more on this comprehensive volcano adventure tour. Gaze at massive active volcano, Mauna Loa that erupted in 2023 and peer into the depths of Kilauea’s Halema’uma’u Crater which has remarkably doubled in size after the 2018 eruption. Watch steam clouds form as ground water seeps onto hot volcanic rock at the famous Steam Vents and stroll through ancient lava tube Nahuku (formerly known as Thurston Lava Tube).
